warnings: Experiment plan, not passing performance evidence; all three earlier 7ceed rounds and the source-b71 CGO=1 round remain failures.

CLI artifacts and non-race core benchmark use shipping CGO=0/GOWORK=off/GOTOOLCHAIN=local; quality race tests are separate. No portable SLA or statistical-significance claim. OS background applications are not controlled; OS caches are not evicted.
Baseline precedes candidate once. No automatic repeat, sample exclusion, fallback, selected-best report or ceiling change.
Twenty read samples use original nearest-rank p95 (19th ordered value); three repair samples still use the observed maximum.
MCP raw durations include its separate first request plus 20 warm samples. max_ms is warm-sample maximum; all_requests_max_ms also includes first.
MCP RSS remains one session-wide peak; per-request RSS is not measured and sample_peak_rss_mib is null, never replicated into invented samples.
Unchanged core benchmark emits 20-sample warm p95, cold time and process RSS only, not raw warm samples/max/per-query RSS. Core RSS includes fixture/calibration.
Fresh CLI rebuild includes startup plus core work; the 10k 10-second target is checked. Both 50k rebuild pairs are reported without an invented 50k ceiling.
A D03 pass is not stable-v1 readiness, D02 success, installed qualification or human approval.
